story.heading: THE STORY OF OUR STUDIO
story.subheading: Massage techniques for rest, personal care and comfort after everyday activity.

0.label: How to prepare for a massage session?
0.body: For comfort, you may wish to schedule a session not immediately after a large meal. A shower before your visit is optional.

1.label: Which massage to choose if it's my first time?
1.body: For the first time, a classic relaxing full-body massage or a back and neck massage is a great choice.

2.label: How often can I have a massage?
2.body: Frequency and number of sessions are chosen individually based on your preferences and comfort. This is not medical advice; consult a physician about health concerns.

3.label: Is it normal to feel pain after a massage?
3.body: Some people may experience temporary muscle sensitivity after an intensive massage. Reactions vary; consult a physician if pain is severe or persists.

cta.heading: We work with muscle tension and offer time to relax and rest after everyday activity.
cta.body: We agree on massage intensity according to your preferences; experiences vary from person to person.

0.label: In what form can I purchase a certificate?
0.body: Digital — we'll send it by email, WhatsApp or Telegram, whichever you prefer. Physical in a gift envelope — you can pick it up at the studio.

1.label: How long is a gift certificate valid?
1.body: The certificate is valid (6 / 12 months) from the date of purchase. The exact term is stated on the voucher.

2.label: What amount or service can a certificate be issued for?
2.body: For any service value, or for a specific treatment / SPA subscription without stating a price.

3.label: Can I add a personal congratulation to the certificate?
3.body: Yes — when ordering, please give the name of the person you're gifting it to, your own name and a message, and we'll add them to the voucher or the digital email.

0.label: What types of massage do you offer at your studio?
0.body: We offer wellness, sports, Swedish, relaxation, lymphatic drainage and cosmetic massage, as well as IQ bodywork. Techniques and intensity are agreed individually.

1.label: How do I know which massage is right for me?
1.body: Before a session we discuss your preferences and possible limitations. We do not provide medical diagnosis; consult a physician with health concerns.

2.label: Can I book a massage if I have back and neck pain?
2.body: We do not diagnose or treat the causes of pain. Consult a physician first about acute or persistent back or neck pain; after that, you can ask whether a session is suitable.

3.label: Where is your studio located?
3.body: We see clients at two branches — in Ramat Gan and Petah Tikva. You can choose whichever location is most convenient for you.

4.label: Can I buy a pass for several sessions?
4.body: Ask us about passes, certificates and gift cards when you contact the studio. Session frequency is chosen individually and is not medical advice.

5.label: How do I book a massage?
5.body: Message us on WhatsApp or Telegram, telling us the service you would like and your preferred branch. We will help you choose a specialist and arrange a time for your visit.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: The TULSANOFF website is for informational purposes only. It has no registration, online booking or other forms for collecting personal information.
privacy.data: The website does not request or store visitors' personal information. If you choose to send contact details or other information to the studio through an external service, that happens outside this website.
privacy.localStorage: To remember your language choice, the website stores a short preference code (tulsanoff.locale) in your browser's localStorage. It is not used to identify or profile visitors.
privacy.thirdParty: The website embeds a Google Maps map. When it loads, Google may receive your IP address and technical connection data. When Hebrew is selected, the browser also loads fonts from Google Fonts. Those providers process data under their own privacy policies, outside the website's control.
privacy.externalLinks: Following telephone, WhatsApp, Telegram, email, social media or map links is your choice. Information you provide through those services is processed by the relevant external providers.
privacy.tracking: The project contains no analytics scripts, advertising pixels or first-party analytics/marketing cookies. The embedded Google map may use Google's own technologies. No analytics or marketing consent banner is used because those tools are not installed on this website.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: TULSANOFF strives to support accessibility in line with Israeli Standard 5568, based on WCAG 2.0 Level AA. This statement describes implemented measures and is not a claim of independent certification.
accessibility.measures: Implemented measures include keyboard navigation, a skip-to-content link, visible focus indicators, semantic landmarks and a consistent heading structure, alt text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images. Text and focus colors are designed for contrast; the layout is responsive and respects reduced-motion preferences. Language and direction attributes update when switching between Russian and Hebrew.
accessibility.limitations: The embedded Google Maps content is provided by a third party and may have accessibility limitations outside TULSANOFF's control. If the site or map is difficult to use, contact the studio by phone or WhatsApp.
accessibility.studio: The studio receives visitors by appointment only.
